sentences.text: Alopiopsis belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, subclass Elasmobranchii, superorder Selachimorpha, order Carcharhiniformes, and family Carcharhinidae.
The recognized species within the genus Alopiopsis is Alopiopsis plejodon.
Fossils of Alopiopsis are found exclusively at Monte Bolca in Italy, and the genus was recognized by Paolo Lioy in 1865.
The genus Alopiopsis lived during the Ypresian stage, from 56 to 48.07 million years ago.
Fossils of this genus date back to more than 40 million years ago.
